content.title: ‘Daredevil: Born Again’ Season 2 Release Schedule—Here’s When New Episodes Drop
content.text: Matt Murdock / Daredevil (Charlie Cox) in Marvel Television's DAREDEVIL: BORN AGAIN, exclusively on Disney+.Marvel TelevisionDaredevil: Born Again is back for another season on Disney+, with Matt Murdock facing his most dangerous battle yet as Mayor Wilson Fisk tightens his grip on New York City. With the premiere now streaming, how long will fans have to wait for new episodes?Created by Dario Scardapane, Chris Ord and Matt Corman, the series follows blind attorney Matt Murdock, who leads a double life as the masked vigilante Daredevil. In Season 2, the newly elected mayor has outlawed vigilantism and turned everyone against Daredevil. Murdock must fight from the shadows to take down the Kingpin’s empire.Showrunner Scardapane teased to Disney that Fisk’s propaganda campaign and Anti-Vigilante Task Force create a “polarized city,” and that Daredevil and Kingpin are no longer adhering to a code of “mutual respect, integrity, and honesty.” He added that now, “those values go out the window when they’re dealing with the other side.”Forbes‘Daredevil: Born Again’ Season 2: Start Time And How To WatchVincent D’Onofrio also hinted that in Season 2 they’ve “provided a springboard” for Wilson Fisk, Matt Murdock, Daredevil and Kingpin to go places fans have never seen them go before. “We had to top ‘I beat you’ from Season 2. We had to top ‘It’s not entirely unpleasant to see you again’ from Season 1. So, we had to bring our A-game,” he said.Charlie Cox and Vincent D’Onofrio reprise their roles as Daredevil and Kingpin, respectively. Season 2 also features the return of fan-favorite characters, including Wilson Bethel as Benjamin Poindexter/Bullseye and Krysten Ritter as Jessica Jones. New additions include Matthew Lillard and Lili Taylor.Here’s everything fans need to know about the second season’s release schedule and how to watch the new episodes.When Do New Episodes of Daredevil: Born Again Season 2 Come Out?L-R: Matt Murdock / Daredevil (Charlie Cox) and Karen Page (Deborah Ann Woll) in Marvel Television's DAREDEVIL: BORN AGAIN, exclusively on Disney+.Marvel Television New episodes of Daredevil: Born Again Season 2 are released Tuesdays at 9 p.m. ET / 6 p.m. PT on Disney+ and Hulu. The first episode, titled “The Northern Star,” is streaming now.How Many Episodes Are In Daredevil: Born Again Season 2?L-R: Matt Murdock / Daredevil (Charlie Cox) and Karen Page (Deborah Ann Woll) in Marvel Television's DAREDEVIL: BORN AGAIN, exclusively on Disney+. JOJO WHILDENThere will be eight episodes in the second season of Daredevil: Born Again, one fewer than the nine-episode first season that premiered on Disney+ in March 2025. The original Daredevil series on Netflix had 13 episodes in each of its three seasons.What Is The Daredevil: Born Again Season 2 Release Schedule?Jessica Jones (Krysten Ritter) in Marvel Television's DAREDEVIL: BORN AGAIN, exclusively on Disney+. Marvel TelevisionThe premiere of Daredevil: Born Again Season 2 was released on Tuesday, March 24. The remaining seven episodes will be released weekly on Tuesdays at 9 p.m. ET. The highly anticipated Season 2 finale is currently slated to air on May 12, 2026.Check out the release schedule for Daredevil: Born Again Season 2 below.Episode 1 (Premiere): Aired March 24, 2026Episode 2: Airing March 31, 2026Episode 3: Airing April 7, 2026Episode 4: Airing April 14, 2026Episode 5: Airing April 21, 2026Episode 6: Airing April 28, 2026Episode 7: Airing May 5, 2026Episode 8 (Finale): Airing April 22, 2026ForbesThe Best New TV Shows Streaming In March 2026 On Netflix, Prime Video And MoreBy Monica MercuriHow To Watch Daredevil: Born Again Season 2L-R: Jessica Jones (Krysten Ritter) and Matt Murdock / Daredevil (Charlie Cox) in Marvel Television's DAREDEVIL: BORN AGAIN, exclusively on Disney+. JOJO WHILDENDaredevil: Born Again Season 2 is streaming on Hulu and Disney+. You can bundle Hulu and Disney+ starting at $12.99 per month. Both services are also available as standalone options, with plans starting at $11.99 per month. Learn more on Hulu’s website.Can You Watch Daredevil: Born Again Season 2 For Free?Hulu is currently offering a free trial to new and eligible returning subscribers, so some viewers may be able to watch the next chapter of Daredevil: Born Again for free.
